Source: `git+https://github.com/ohos-rs/winit-ohos.git?rev=af4063b4e75b62b152a315d2606d799ca65bda84#af4063b4e75b62b152a315d2606d799ca65bda84`.

The package is renamed for the Jadix release dependency closure. Internal dependency aliases preserve Rust API names and point to versioned maintained packages; window backends share registry `dpi =0.1.2`. Existing source patches and their JADIX_PATCH/README explanations remain in this directory where applicable. Original copyright and license files are retained: LICENSE-APACHE, LICENSE-MIT.

Package availability and ownership must be checked in the target registry; this provenance record identifies the maintained source.
